about_the_game:
WTP - Story 1 is a dynamic, choice-led, sci-fi mystery adventure.

The game is in a first-person perspective and is set in a fictionalized future where not all is as it seems as the player decides how to deal with the reality they find themselves in.

Conduct research. Investigate. Travel. Decide who you will be.
Suss out who you can trust and who you can not trust.
Every choice matters.

Every choice made shapes the results that follow, the relationships, and the possible results.

Decide how you will act and your choices will shape the world and events.

Features

Highly dynamic dialog, multiple paths, dynamic elements, mini-games, and side content adds replay value to the game.

Set custom names for the major characters in the game.

Set options that adjust gameplay including toggling mini-games, an option to minimize swearing, and an option to minimize violence.

Set your pronouns. The game supports a protagonist with any of the following pronouns: She, He, They, Hu, Fae, Hir, Ey, Ze, and Xe.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature content in the game can be limited / almost entirely removed per player preference.

The game contains no sexually explicit content 

The game contains some language that some players may find offensive. (No hate speech. Just the use of sware words.)

The game allows the player to make choices and at times the player can choose to make the choice to use violence.

To help ensure a fun and enjoyable gameplay experience for a wider audience of responsible adults, content choices are offered to minimize these aspects of the game. 

Minimized elements may still appear in the game, this is NOT parental controls,  it is simply about being accommodating to player preferences/sensitivities by allowing players to reduce the offensive content to minimal/low levels. 

Players may choose to minimize the use of offensive language and or minimize the use of violent content.

The option to minimize offensive language replaces many of the swear words that are used with less offensive words or descriptive words. 

The option to minimize the use of violent content removes a number of options during the game where the player could otherwise choose to use violence. 

One indirect reference to self-harm can be found in the game. The player can possibly uncover a piece of information showing that one of the characters at some point in the past contemplated self-harm,   Finding it is not required and you have to go snooping to find it.
